app.description: DXF nesting desktop application with live preview and production DXF export.
app.localProcessing: All nesting and preprocessing run locally using bundled helper executables. The app does not download code at runtime, does not require network access for core functionality, and terminates helper processes when quitting.

settings.title: Settings
settings.measurementUnitsHelp: Auto follows the measurement system associated with your operating-system region.
settings.multiSheetHelp: Only applies when running placements on multiple sheets. Auto uses the unified packer recommended for most jobs. The other options divide parts between sheets before placement.
settings.multipleSketches: Detect multiple sketches in one DXF
settings.joinLineworkHelp: Best effort. Joins end-to-end LINE entities into larger polylines during DXF export. It does not bridge gaps or merge separate bodies.
settings.sheetOutlineHelp: Adds the physical sheet boundary as a closed polyline on the SHEET_BOUNDARY layer. Leave disabled unless your CAD or CAM workflow requires a stock outline.
settings.automaticCrashReportsHelp: When enabled, locally captured crash reports are sent after the app restarts following a crash. DXF files and nesting projects are not intentionally included.

sheet.fixedHelp: Fixed sheet size; the number of sheets is calculated automatically.
sheet.maxHelp: Length is the maximum; sheets may be shorter and the count is calculated automatically.
sheet.unlimitedHelp: Strip length has no limit; the engine uses whatever it needs.
sheet.automaticHelp: The algorithm will calculate the number of sheets automatically.
